Madam Lucretious,[1][2] also known as Bringer of the Night or Mama Lucretious, is a high elven[3] necromancer and the ringmaster of the Circus of the Last Days.
“
Oh dear. Screaming children, an oozing corpse - and it's not even my birthday.
„
— Lucretious

Overview

Description

Lucretious is flamboyant, commanding, and flirty, with a larger-than-life personality and a dramatic flair. She is composed and well spoken.

She has high standards and is dedicated to the success of her circus; currently she is attempting to train a troupe of dancing skeletons as a possible opening act for Dribbles.

As a powerful wizard, Lucretious provides protection for her circus.[4][5] Some members are so confident in her protection, they aren't afraid of the threat of the Absolute and its approaching army. If threatened, Popper may reveal he is unafraid to lose his fingers because he is certain she could replace them.[6]

As a necromancer, Lucretious has a very casual attitude towards death; she sees corpses as a useful resource and shows insincere sympathy at the death of Dribbles.[7] When first encountered in the back of the circus, she is accompanied by three skeletons named  Lucille,  Boris, and  Jacob, and two crawling claws named  Itchy and  Scratchy.[8]

[9] She genuinely enjoys her work, and when she finds out she will have to put Dribbles' body back together, she is excited by the prospect of a challenge.[10][11]

"Wine-lover extraordinaire" is a part of her self-introduction, and she may refer to the character as a “delectable vintage.”[12]

Lucretious claims to be quite old, even ancient.[13][14]

Her flirting is not reserved for the party members; a woman can be found in the Counting House intending to run away to the circus, citing the way she looked at her.[15]

Involvement

After  Dribbles' show and discovering that he was replaced by a  Doppelganger, Lucretious intends to move the circus elsewhere, but will not do so until the remains of her audience-beloved Dribbles are found. She asks the party to find the scattered body parts of Dribbles so she can reanimate him and continue to use him as part of the circus.

If the party return with all seven of Dribbles' missing body parts, Lucretious thanks them for returning the star of her show and rewards them with  Spellmight Gloves (or a small amount of gold if the gloves were previously pickpocketed). She lets the party know that the circus will finally leave soon (after the next long rest), so they should buy from its merchants while they still can.

Notes and references

  1. ↑ Madam Lucretious's voice actor, Daniel Jacob, is a drag queen known as ⁠Vinegar Strokes, and has performed on RuPaul's Drag Race.
  2. ↑ One of the use earliest uses of the similar name "Lucretius" likely comes from Titus Lucretius Carus (c. 99–55 BC), a Roman poet and philosopher. He is best known for his epic didactic poem ⁠De Rerum Natura ("On the Nature of Things"), which introduced Epicurean philosophy and atomism to the Roman world.
  3. ↑ Despite being an elf, Lucretious originally had non-pointed, human ears. This was fixed in Patch 3.
  4. ↑  Fyodor: "Lucretious dead - circus unprotected. We leave - no choice."
  5. ↑  Klaus: "They say the Absolute's cronies have been busy chopping people up like it's going out of style."
    Klaus: "They won't go near us, of course - Lucretious, Bringer of Night, protects us."
    Klaus: "And even the Absolute knows better than to tangle with a necromancer."
  6. ↑  Popper: "Cut Popper's hands into juicy bits if you likes - Mama Lucretious can make new fingies for me!"
  7. ↑ Lucretious: "Oh dear - Dribbles' flesh is near torn asunder. Poor thing was most certainly alive when he was hacked up."
  8. ↑ Itchy and Scratchy are probably named after the characters in the ⁠The Itchy & Scratchy Show, a show within a show in ⁠The Simpsons television show.
  9. ↑ Lucretious: "Ohhh, getting hacked up like that must have been unpleasant - poor dear."
  10. ↑ Necromancer Player Character: "Dribbles is dead, but perhaps I could help you resurrect him?"
    Lucretious: "Darling, you know half the fun with these things is getting your own hands dirty."
  11. ↑ Lucretious: "If you bring whatever you find to me, I'll take it from there. I'm a necromancer after all - and I do so love a challenge."
  12. ↑ According to  Edmundis Magarus, she is very particular and does not allow the redcaps to organize the wine:
     Fist Patrick: "How many redcaps are in a 'handful'?"
    Edmundis Magarus: "Enough to clean Crimson's cage but not enough to organise the wine - Madam Lucretious is very particular."
  13. ↑ Player character: "Let's talk payment. I'm expensive."
    Lucretious: "Heh. I can respect that. And you're in luck - because I am old, darling. Ancient. I have seen stars explode and civilisations fall."
    Lucretious: "Along the way, I happened across items of such power, they would make you weep with awe."
  14. ↑ Lucretious: "You do not live to see the turn of millennia by being stupid - sorry. 'Brave'."
  15. ↑  Gilla Merrun: "If you're one of Barek's friends sent to talk me down, tell him I've made up my mind! I'm buying that stake in the circus and running away!"
    Gilla Merrun: "You don't understand. Barek doesn't understand. The way Ringmaster Lucretious looked at me…"
